sections.legal_html: By clicking "Complete Purchase," you agree to enroll in an automatically-renewing subscription. Your initial payment will be refunded if medication is not prescribed after your initial consultation. Your second shipment may be charged and shipped up to 10 days early to prevent treatment gaps. Refills occur every 28 days and you must complete a refill form each refill period to ensure appropriate dosage. Your subscription will renew automatically at the end of each subscription term and you will be charged accordingly, regardless of whether you receive a refill. Your subscription will renew unless you cancel at least 48 hours before your renewal date through your account settings. You also agree to Chime Health Privacy Policy, Terms of Service and Telehealth Consent.
